items.example: I tried to smooth things over after the argument.
items.simple: To make a problem or fight feel smaller and calmer.
items.note: smooth things over olarak çok kullanılır.

items.example: Let's talk and clear the air.
items.simple: Talk honestly about a problem so the bad feeling goes away.

items.example: You'll need to tread carefully with her right now.
items.exampleTr: Şu an onunla temkinli davranman lazım.
items.simple: Be very careful, because it is easy to make someone upset.

items.example: They finally patched things up last week.
items.simple: To fix a friendship after a fight, and be friends again.

items.example: He made a joke to defuse the tension.
items.simple: To take away the angry feeling so nothing bad happens.

items.example: I had to mediate between my two brothers.
items.exampleTr: İki kardeşimin arasında arabuluculuk yapmak zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: To help two people who are fighting to find a good answer.

items.example: That wasn't very tactful of you.
items.exampleTr: Bu pek de ince düşünceli değildi.
items.simple: Saying hard things in a kind way so people do not feel bad.

items.example: There's a lot of resentment in the team.
items.exampleTr: Takımda çok içten içe kızgınlık var.
items.simple: An angry feeling that stays inside for a long time.

items.example: The argument caused a rift between the sisters.
items.exampleTr: Tartışma kız kardeşlerin arasına soğukluk soktu.
items.simple: A big gap between two people after a fight.

items.example: Let's not let this escalate into a fight.
items.simple: To get bigger and worse and more serious.

items.example: Both sides had to make a concession.
items.exampleTr: İki tarafın da taviz vermesi gerekti.
items.simple: Something you agree to give up so the other person is happier.

items.example: He's still bitter about how it ended.
items.simple: Still sad and angry about something unfair from the past.

items.example: Come on, let's bury the hatchet.
items.simple: Stop being angry at each other and be friends again.

items.example: I'll meet you halfway on the price.
items.simple: You give a little, they give a little, so you agree.

items.example: We'll just have to agree to disagree.
items.simple: You stop arguing, because you both think differently.

items.tr: huzuru korumak, kavga çıkmasın diye uğraşmak
items.example: I only said yes to keep the peace.
items.exampleTr: Sadece huzur bozulmasın diye evet dedim.
items.simple: Do something so that nobody gets angry or starts a fight.

items.example: I don't want to take sides in this.
items.simple: To say that one person is right and the other is wrong.

items.example: Money has always been a bone of contention for them.
items.exampleTr: Para onlar için hep bir tartışma konusu oldu.
items.simple: Something two people keep arguing about again and again.

items.en: rub someone up the wrong way
items.example: He just rubs me up the wrong way.
items.simple: Someone does small things that make you feel annoyed.

items.example: I often clash with my manager over deadlines.
items.exampleTr: Müdürümle teslim tarihleri yüzünden sık sık ters düşüyorum.
items.simple: To have different ideas and keep arguing with someone.

items.example: They had a heated argument in the car park.
items.simple: A loud fight where people feel very angry.

items.example: Tensions were running high before the final.
items.simple: People feel very nervous and angry with each other.

items.example: He gave a very diplomatic answer.
items.simple: A reply that is polite and does not hurt anyone's feelings.

items.en: Let's not make this a bigger deal than it is.
items.tr: Bunu olduğundan daha büyük bir mesele yapmayalım.
items.example: Let's not make this a bigger deal than it is.
items.exampleTr: Bunu olduğundan daha büyük bir mesele yapmayalım.
items.simple: You ask people to stay calm because the problem is small.

items.en: I see where you're coming from, but…
items.example: I see where you're coming from, but I disagree.
items.exampleTr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama katılmıyorum.
items.simple: You show you understand someone's idea, then say a different idea.
